scripts.dev: concurrently -k --success command-electron -n renderer,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:renderer" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.make: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/vendor-ghostscript-win.cjs && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && electron-forge make
scripts.make:dmg: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && electron-forge make --targets=@electron-forge/maker-dmg
scripts.make:pkg: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && electron-forge make --targets=./forge-makers/maker-rx-pkg.ts
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/vendor-ghostscript-win.cjs && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=win32 && node scripts/build-print-service.cjs && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && node scripts/write-app-update-yml.cjs win32 && electron-builder --prepackaged "out/Rx-Connect-win32-x64" --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:win:publish: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/vendor-ghostscript-win.cjs && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=win32 && node scripts/build-print-service.cjs && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && node scripts/write-app-update-yml.cjs win32 && electron-builder --prepackaged "out/Rx-Connect-win32-x64" --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && node scripts/build-print-service.cjs && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && node scripts/write-app-update-yml.cjs darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --prepackaged "out/Rx-Connect-darwin-arm64" --mac zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:publish: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && node scripts/build-print-service.cjs && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && node scripts/write-app-update-yml.cjs darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --prepackaged "out/Rx-Connect-darwin-arm64" --mac zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.dist:mac:x64: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:renderer && node scripts/download-hugo.cjs --platform=current && node scripts/build-print-service.cjs && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && node scripts/write-app-update-yml.cjs darwin-x64 && electron-builder --prepackaged "out/Rx-Connect-darwin-x64" --mac zip --x64 --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
